preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 5.
The lengths of strings a and b must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in a) and all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in b)
preconditions.description: Both strings a and b must contain only uppercase letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically minimal string formed by concatenating and sorting the letters from both stacks.
